scenarios.scenario: Surface — Identify build error from binlog (missing file copy)
scenarios.reasoning: The agent efficiently identified the build error in just one tool call, correctly named the project, error code, target framework, and provided useful context about what went wrong. The only minor gap is the truncated file path, though this was partly due to the tool output being truncated. The agent could have made a follow-up query to get the full error message.
